name: Home → Crosscut 50k
description: Hankering for some za but too lazy to get in my car. My second planned water stop had scary no trespassing signs so I thought id just hold out for Gross Resevoir but news flash there is no water there. Saved by a nice young family who let me use their spigot and were clearly endurance athletes because they asked if I needed any gels. Made my day and totally saved the run. I spent 15 minutes looking for a TH that was an integral part of the original route and I’m not convinced it’s actually there. A bit hot but feeling very adapted. Flybys with a few names - Allison Baca, Floyd Landis, and Allie Ostrander. I can name and identify approximately zero sportsball athletes but I'm starting to know the endurance world a bit. Gross Dam Resevoir would be killer for hill sprints but there wasn't even a segment on it yet!
